verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot Chat is embedded in Teams and can surface insights from Microsoft Graph/work data (Work IQ) and web data, which is the core of this story. However, evidence is thin—just brief doc snippets with no detail on specific insight types, no hands-on demonstration, and no independent corroboration of quality; missing for 10: detailed documentation of specific AI-generated insights/suggestions features, hands-on or independent validation of their usefulness, and any community feedback specifically on Copilot's in-product insights (community evidence only covers unrelated UX complaints).
